verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP endpoint at docs.mangopay.com/_mcp/server, and the 'Build with AI' docs and llms.txt instructions for AI agents show deliberate agent support. The /_mcp path on the docs site suggests this is a docs-hosted server, likely for documentation search rather than API operations, and nothing describes its tools, auth or setup. missing for 10: documented MCP tool list and scope (API actions vs docs search), connection/auth setup instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
